articles.title: Eutelsat orders 340 additional satellites to replenish OneWeb constellation
articles.summary:
Eutelsat has ordered the remaining 340 satellites needed to replenish its OneWeb satellite constellation from Airbus Defence and Space.

articles.title: NASA’s Webb Delivers Unprecedented Look Into Heart of Circinus Galaxy
articles.summary: The Circinus Galaxy, a galaxy about 13 million light-years away, contains an active supermassive black hole that continues to influence its evolution. articles.title: ATD water-cooled throttleable engine firing
articles.summary: Romanian company ATD Aerospace RS SRL is developing a 10 kN rocket engine that can be re-ignited and adjust its thrust. This builds on the 1 kN engine they developed with support from the European Space Agency (ESA).

articles.title: A Plume of Bright Blue in Melissa’s Wake
articles.summary: The category 5 hurricane stirred up carbonate sediment near Jamaica in what scientists believe is the largest such event in the satellite record.
